scope: Three targeted offline behavioral checks only; not scenario or hardware acceptance.

checks.criterion: Partial evidence and guarded abort/HOLD recovery with fresh state
evidence: On failure/stop, preserve completed frames/contacts and `ending` plus the reported retreat state.
Normal recoverable aborts use only the runner’s guarded **straight-up** park retreat
Held contact, `abort-held`, overtravel, connection closure or uncertain retreat means **HOLD**—no outer raise, no `on_fail:skip` continuation.
Inspect `ending`, complete/partial `result`, final pose and sensor state before the next phase.
Any later manual recovery requires a new explicit instruction, available page budget, re-established safety state and a Z-only park move before replanning
checks.source: .agents/skills/cnc-motion-rules/SKILL.md law 8; .agents/skills/cnc-camera-operations/SKILL.md Approval accounting and handoff; src/server/services/mcp/cameraRecovery.ts

checks.criterion: One question batch and at most seven actual confirm pages, including optional branches
evidence: If an answer needed later remains unavailable, the dependent branch stops rather than producing a second question batch
Bootstrap search and poses: 2; coarse survey: 1; applicable B / missing datum program: 1; fine survey: 1; spare pool: at most 2 total; maximum: 7.
A page spent on one optional branch is unavailable to another. Keep a running ledger; reserve all remaining dependent core phases before using a spare.
If calibration, a failed bootstrap and refinement together would exceed seven, stop with explicit unresolved scope.

checks.criterion: Ordinary snapshot IDs/files retained and archives retrieved beyond eviction/restart alongside job images
evidence: Keep frame IDs, `camera.file`, timestamps, camera identity, resolution and stamped machine XYZ/B.
Archived snapshots are retrievable with `get_frame {"frame_id":"<saved>"}` or `get_frame {"file":"<camera.file>"}` beyond the 12-frame RAM cache and across restarts.
Survey frames use their indexed server files. Retrieve them before proposing replacement captures.

limitations: No obvious unsafe or schema-invalid additional instruction encountered in this targeted read; this is not an exhaustive schema audit. No machine, MCP, network, device, build or test access performed.
